house.description: Requirement that the term incumbent be printed next to the incumbent candidate's name on ballot repealed.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Elections Finance and Government Operations

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Elections Finance and Government Operations

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to elections; judicial offices; repealing requirement that the term incumbent be printed next to the incumbent candidate's name on the ballot; repealing Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 204B.36, subdivision 5.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+REPEALER. +]

[+Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 204B.36, subdivision 5,+]

[+ is repealed. +]

APPENDIX
Repealed Minnesota Statutes: 25-01194

204B.36 BALLOTS; FORM.

Subd. 5.
Designation of incumbent; judicial offices.
If a chief justice, associate justice, or judge is a candidate to succeed again, the word "incumbent" shall be printed after that judge's name as a candidate.
